---
title: "CENS"
---

I've been part of the [Council for Emerging and New Statisticians (CENS)](https://cens-enar.github.io/cens_website/) since 2024, and it's been one of the most rewarding parts of my professional life. CENS operates under [ENAR](https://www.enar.org/) — the Eastern North American Region of the International Biometric Society — with the tagline "By early career, for early career." Since its founding in 2012, the committee has focused on meeting the specific needs of students and early-career statisticians through mentorship, networking, and professional development. Getting to help shape that programming, first from the Steering Committee and now as Co-Chair, has been a genuine privilege — CENS gave a lot to me when I was newer to the field, and contributing to its mission for the next generation of statisticians is work I care about deeply.
